a.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, /**估值日**/ '' AS lastPeriod, /**剩余期限**/ a.CLOSE_PRICE AS cloPrice, /**收盘价**/ a.AVERAGE_PRICE AS avgPrice, /**平均价**/ a.BUY_ONE_PRICE AS buyOnePrice, /**买一价**/ a.SELL_ONE_PRICE AS sellOnePrice, /**卖一价**/ a.MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, /**最高价**/ a.MIN_PRICE AS minPrice, /**最低价**/
a.CLOSE_PRICE_FULL AS cloPriceFull, /**收盘价全价**/ a.AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL AS avgPriceFull, /**平均价全价**/ a.BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL AS buyOnePriceFull, /**买一价全价**/ a.SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL AS sellOnePriceFull, /**卖一价全价**/ a.MAX_PRICE_FULL AS maxPriceFull, /**最高价全价**/ a.MIN_PRICE_FULL AS minPriceFull /**最低价全价**/
FROM mst_BOND_MARKET_INFO a

AND c.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE '%' || #{finprodAbbr,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND a.VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND a.VALUE_DATE >= to_date(#{valueDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND a.VALUE_DATE <= to_date(#{valueDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')

mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_BOND_MARKET_INFO CII USING (
select #{item.secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SEC_ID, to_date(#{item.valueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') VALUE_DATE, #{item.cloPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CLOSE_PRICE, #{item.avgPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AVERAGE_PRICE, #{item.buyOnePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} BUY_ONE_PRICE, #{item.sellOnePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} SELL_ONE_PRICE, #{item.maxPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} MAX_PRICE, #{item.minPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} MIN_PRICE, #{item.cloPriceFull,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CLOSE_PRICE_FULL, #{item.avgPriceFull,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL, #{item.buyOnePriceFull,jdbcType=DECIMAL} BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL, #{item.sellOnePriceFull,jdbcType=DECIMAL} SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL, #{item.maxPriceFull,jdbcType=DECIMAL} MAX_PRICE_FULL, #{item.minPriceFull,jdbcType=DECIMAL} MIN_PRICE_FULL, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT from dual
) TEMP
ON (CII.SEC_ID = TEMP.SEC_ID AND CII.VALUE_DATE = TEMP.VALUE_DATE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
CII.CLOSE_PRICE = TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE, CII.AVERAGE_PRICE = TEMP.AVERAGE_PRICE, CII.BUY_ONE_PRICE = TEMP.BUY_ONE_PRICE, CII.SELL_ONE_PRICE = TEMP.SELL_ONE_PRICE, CII.MAX_PRICE = TEMP.MAX_PRICE, CII.MIN_PRICE =TEMP.MIN_PRICE, CII.CLOSE_PRICE_FULL = TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE_FULL, CII.AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL = TEMP.AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL, CII.BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL = TEMP.BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL, CII.SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL = TEMP.SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL, CII.MAX_PRICE_FULL = TEMP.MAX_PRICE_FULL, CII.MIN_PRICE_FULL = TEMP.MIN_PRICE_FULL, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEC_ID,VALUE_DATE,CLOSE_PRICE,AVERAGE_PRICE,BUY_ONE_PRICE,SELL_ONE_PRICE ,MAX_PRICE,MIN_PRICE,CLOSE_PRICE_FULL,AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL,BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL ,SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL,MAX_PRICE_FULL,MIN_PRICE_FULL,CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME ,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) values( TEMP.SEC_ID,TEMP.VALUE_DATE,TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE,TEMP.AVERAGE_PRICE,TEMP.BUY_ONE_PRICE, TEMP.SELL_ONE_PRICE,TEMP.MAX_PRICE,TEMP.MIN_PRICE,TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE_FULL,TEMP.AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL, TEMP.BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL,TEMP.SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL,TEMP.MAX_PRICE_FULL,TEMP.MIN_PRICE_FULL, TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
